data.long_meaning: Tetea is a Hindu name that means 'Goddess of Love and Beauty'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Triveni', which refers to the three holy rivers - Ganga, Yamuna, and Saraswati. Tetea is believed to bring happiness, love, and prosperity to the one who bears this name. The name Tetea carries the meaning “Goddess of Love and Beauty” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Tetea usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of love and beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
